en.t: Pope Stephen III is elected to office, and quickly seeks Frankish protection against the Lombard threat, since the Byzantine Empire is no longer able to help
en.s: Pope Stephen III (Latin: Stephanus III; 720 – 24 January 772) was the bishop of Rome and leader of the Papal States from 7 August 768 to his death on 24 January 772. Stephen was a Benedictine monk who worked in the Lateran Palace during the reign of Pope Zachary. In the midst of a tumultuous contest by rival factions to name a successor to Pope Paul I, Stephen was elected with the support of the Roman officials.

zh.t: 教宗斯德望三世当选教宗，并迅速寻求法兰克人的保护，以抵御伦巴第人的威胁，因为拜占庭帝国已无力提供援助
zh.s: 教宗斯德望三世（拉丁语：Stephanus III；720年—772年1月24日）于768年8月7日起担任罗马主教和教宗国领袖，直至772年1月24日去世。他是本笃会修士，曾在匝加利亚教宗在位期间于拉特朗宫任职。教宗保禄一世去世后，各派系激烈争夺继任者人选；斯德望在罗马官员支持下当选。

en.t: Coronation of King Otto I of Germany
en.s: Otto I (23 November 912 – 7 May 973), known as Otto the Great (German: Otto der Große; Italian: Ottone il Grande) or Otto of Saxony (German: Otto von Sachsen; Italian: Ottone di Sassonia), was an East Frankish (German) king from 936 and Holy Roman Emperor from 962 until his death in 973. He was the eldest son of Henry the Fowler and Matilda of Ringelheim.

zh.t: 德国国王奥托一世加冕
zh.s: 奥托一世（912年11月23日—973年5月7日），称奥托大帝（德语：Otto der Große；意大利语：Ottone il Grande）或萨克森的奥托（德语：Otto von Sachsen；意大利语：Ottone di Sassonia），自936年起担任东法兰克（德意志）国王，962年至973年去世前担任神圣罗马帝国皇帝。他是捕鸟者亨利与林格尔海姆的玛蒂尔达的长子。

en.s: Battle of Mellrichstadt was fought between Holy Roman Emperor Henry IV and the German anti-king Rudolf of Swabia on 7 August 1078 near Mellrichstadt. Henry's army met the army of Rudolf's Saxon allies before they could meet up with the Swabians. In the confusion, one Saxon force including the bishops Werner of Magdeburg and Werner of Merseburg and Rudolf fled as soon as the armies met.

zh.s: 1078年8月7日，神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利四世与德国反国王施瓦本的鲁道夫在梅尔里希施塔特附近交战。亨利的军队赶在鲁道夫的萨克森盟军与施瓦本军会合前，先与萨克森人交战。双方交战时局势混乱，一支萨克森部队连同鲁道夫以及马格德堡主教维尔纳和梅泽堡主教维尔纳一同逃离。

en.s: The Battle of Varey took place on 7 August 1325 in what is now the commune of Saint-Jean-le-Vieux, in the French department of Ain. It was between troops of the Count of Savoy and the Dauphin of Viennois as part of an ongoing war between the two neighbouring provinces.

zh.s: 瓦雷战役于1325年8月7日在今法国安省圣让勒维厄市镇境内爆发。交战双方是萨伏依伯爵的军队和维埃努瓦王储的军队，属于这两个相邻地区之间持续战争的一部分。

en.s: The Rebellion of Cao Qin (simplified Chinese: 曹钦之变; traditional Chinese: 曹欽之變; pinyin: Cáoshí Zhī Biàn) was a day-long uprising in the Ming dynasty capital of Beijing on August 7, 1461, staged by Chinese general Cao Qin (曹欽; died 1461) and his Ming troops of Mongol and Han descent against the Tianshun Emperor (r. 1457–1464).

zh.s: 曹钦之变（简体中文：曹钦之变；繁体中文：曹欽之變；拼音：Cáoshí Zhī Biàn）是明朝京师北京于1461年8月7日发生的一场持续一天的起义。明朝将领曹钦（卒于1461年）率领蒙古族和汉族出身的明军士兵发动起义，反抗天顺帝（在位于1457—1464年）。

en.s: The First Battle of Guinegate took place on 7 August 1479. King Louis XI's French troops, led by Philippe de Crèvecœur d'Esquerdes (who had been a commander under Charles the Bold but defected to the French side after the latter's death in 1477), were defeated by the Burgundians, led by Duke (later Emperor) Maximilian I of Habsburg.

zh.s: 第一次吉讷盖特战役于1479年8月7日爆发。路易十一的法军由菲利普·德·克雷弗科尔·德埃斯克德尔率领；他曾是大胆查理麾下的指挥官，后于1477年查理死后叛投法国。法军被勃艮第军队击败，勃艮第军由哈布斯堡的马克西米利安一世公爵（后来的皇帝）率领。

en.s: The siege of Oudewater was an event during the Eighty Years' War that took place in the Dutch town of Oudewater, culminating in the Oudewater Massacre ((in Dutch) Oudewaterse moord). The siege by Spanish troops started on 19 July 1575 and ended on 7 August 1575, when the town was taken by storm and plundered.

zh.s: 奥德瓦特围城战是八十年战争期间发生在荷兰城镇奥德瓦特的事件，最终演变为奥德瓦特大屠杀（荷兰语：Oudewaterse moord）。西班牙军队于1575年7月19日开始围城，并于同年8月7日攻占城镇，随后洗劫全城。

en.t: Battle of the Ford of the Biscuits
en.s: The Battle of the Ford of the Biscuits took place in County Fermanagh, Ireland on 7 August 1594 when a force of Irish Army soldiers led by Sir Henry Duke was ambushed and defeated by a rebel force under Hugh Maguire in the region of the fords of the Arney River on the approaches to Enniskillen. Duke's men were a relief column for the town which had been under siege since May. The battle acquired its distinctive name due to the supplies of the Crown forces, largely hard biscuits, which were scattered and left floating in the river.

zh.s: 饼干渡口战役于1594年8月7日在爱尔兰弗马纳郡爆发。亨利·杜克爵士率领的爱尔兰军队在厄恩河渡口一带、通往恩尼斯基林的路上遭休·马圭尔率领的叛军伏击并被击败。杜克率军前来增援该镇；恩尼斯基林自5月起一直遭到围困。这场战斗因王室军队的补给品散落并漂浮在河面上而得名，其中大多是硬饼干。

en.t: Battle of the Gulf of Cádiz
en.s: The Battle of the Gulf of Cádiz was a naval action which occurred on 7 August 1604. The battle took place when a flotilla of two galleons commanded by Antonio de Oquendo engaged two English corsairs in the service of the Barbary States who were plundering shipping lanes and villages from Galicia to the Gulf of Cádiz. One of the English ships was captured and the other damaged.

zh.s: 加的斯湾海战于1604年8月7日爆发。安东尼奥·德·奥肯多率领两艘西班牙大帆船，在加利西亚至加的斯湾航线上与两艘为巴巴里国家效力、劫掠商船和沿岸村庄的英国私掠船交战。西班牙俘获其中一艘英国船，另一艘受损。

en.s: The Battle of Werben took place during the Thirty Years' War on 7 August 1631 (N.S.), between the Swedish Empire and the Holy Roman Empire. The Swedes had 15,100 soldiers and were led by Gustavus Adolphus, while the Imperialists had 16,200 soldiers and were led by Field-Marshal Count Tilly.

zh.s: 韦尔本战役于1631年8月7日爆发，是三十年战争期间瑞典帝国与神圣罗马帝国之间的一场战斗。瑞典军队有15,100人，由古斯塔夫·阿道夫率领；帝国军有16,200人，由蒂利伯爵、陆军元帅约翰·策尔克莱斯指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Zhovnyn was an engagement between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under hetman Mikołaj Potocki, supported by the forces under magnate Jeremi Wiśniowiecki, and Cossacks commanded by Yakiv Ostryanyn (Polish: Jakub Ostrzanin) and Dmytro Hunia during the Ostryanyn Uprising in Summer 1638. After a prolonged siege, the Cossacks were defeated and surrendered to the Commonwealth forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 若夫宁战役发生于1638年夏季奥斯特里亚宁起义期间。波兰立陶宛联邦军队由赫特曼米科瓦伊·波托茨基指挥，并得到大贵族耶雷米·维希尼奥维茨基所部支援；哥萨克军队则由雅基夫·奥斯特里亚宁（波兰语：Jakub Ostrzanin）和德米特罗·胡尼亚指挥。经过长期围城，哥萨克军队战败并向联邦军队投降。

en.s: The Battle of Portlester took place on 7 August 1643 near the town of Portlester, Leinster in Ireland as part of the Irish Confederate Wars. It was fought between the Ulster Army under Owen Roe O'Neill and a largely Protestant government force from Dublin under Lord Moore, with both sides proclaiming their basic loyalty to Charles I. In a largely indecisive battle the two armies exchanged artillery fire, during which the Protestant commander Lord Moore was killed. His army withdrew handing the Irish Confederates a strategic victory.

zh.s: 波特莱斯特战役于1643年8月7日在爱尔兰伦斯特省波特莱斯特镇附近爆发，是爱尔兰邦联战争中的一场战斗。交战双方是欧文·罗·奥尼尔率领的阿尔斯特军，以及摩尔勋爵率领的一支主要由新教徒组成、来自都柏林的政府军；双方都表示基本效忠查理一世。战斗大致未分胜负，双方互相炮击，期间新教政府军指挥官摩尔勋爵阵亡。政府军随后撤退，爱尔兰邦联军因此取得战略胜利。

en.s: The battle of Pielis occurred on 7 August 1657 in Kajaani during the Russo-Swedish War of 1656–1658. A Russian force estimated at some 300 men were raiding the province when a Finnish force under the command of Zacharias Palmbaum encountered them and managed to repel the Russians after intense fighting.

zh.s: 皮耶利斯战役于1657年8月7日在卡亚尼爆发，属于1656—1658年俄瑞战争的一部分。约300名俄罗斯士兵在该省劫掠时，遭遇扎卡里亚斯·帕尔姆鲍姆指挥的芬兰部队。经过激烈战斗，芬兰部队击退了俄军。

en.s: The Battle of Orford Ness was fought between a southbound Swedish merchant convoy escorted by the 56-gun ship of the line Öland and an English squadron of eight ships of the line and a frigate off Orford Ness on 7 August 1704. The English squadron, under Rear-admiral William Whetstone, began following the convoy upon sighting it.

zh.s: 1704年8月7日，瑞典一支南下的商船队由搭载56门炮的“厄兰”号战列舰护航，在奥福德角外海遭遇一支英国分舰队。英军有8艘战列舰和1艘护卫舰，由海军少将威廉·惠斯通率领。发现瑞典船队后，英军开始跟踪。

en.s: The Battle of Gangut (Russian: Гангутское сражение; Finnish: Riilahden taistelu; Finland Swedish: Slaget vid Rilax; Swedish: Sjöslaget vid Hangö udd) took place on 27 JulyJul./ 7 August 1714Greg. during the Great Northern War (1700–1721), in the waters of Riilahti Bay, north of the Hanko Peninsula, near the site of the modern-day city of Hanko (Hangö), Finland, between the Swedish Navy and Imperial Russian Navy. It was the first important victory of the Russian fleet in its history. It is commemorated in Russia as one of the Days of Military Honour.

zh.s: 汉科角海战（俄语：Гангутское сражение；芬兰语：Riilahden taistelu；芬兰瑞典语：Slaget vid Rilax；瑞典语：Sjöslaget vid Hangö udd）于1714年7月27日儒略历（格里历8月7日）爆发，属于大北方战争（1700—1721年）的一部分。战斗发生在芬兰汉科半岛以北的里拉赫蒂湾，靠近今汉科市，由瑞典海军对阵俄罗斯帝国海军。这是俄罗斯舰队历史上的首场重要胜利之一。俄罗斯将这场战役列为军事荣誉日予以纪念。

en.t: The Treaty of Åbo ends the 1741–1743 Russo-Swedish War
en.s: The Treaty of Åbo, or the Treaty of Turku, was a peace treaty signed between the Russian Empire and Sweden in Åbo (Turku) on 18 August [O.S. 7 August] 1743 in the end of the Russo-Swedish War of 1741–1743.

zh.t: 奥布条约结束1741–1743年俄瑞战争
zh.s: 奥布条约（又称图尔库条约）是俄罗斯帝国与瑞典签署的和平条约，于1743年8月18日（儒略历8月7日）在奥布（今图尔库）签署，结束了1741年至1743年的俄瑞战争。

en.s: The Second Silesian War (German: Zweiter Schlesischer Krieg) was a war between Prussia and Austria that lasted from 1744 to 1745 and confirmed Prussia's control of the region of Silesia (now in south-western Poland). The war was fought mainly in Silesia, Bohemia, and Upper Saxony and formed one theatre of the wider War of the Austrian Succession.

zh.s: 第二次西里西亚战争（德语：Zweiter Schlesischer Krieg）是普鲁士与奥地利之间的一场战争，持续于1744年至1745年，最终确认普鲁士对西里西亚（今波兰西南部）的控制。战争主要在西里西亚、波希米亚和上萨克森进行，也是更大范围的奥地利王位继承战争的一个战场。

en.s: The Battle of Orsova was a military engagement between the Habsbug and the Ottoman armies during the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791. The Ottomans were victorious and routed the Austrians.

zh.s: 奥尔绍瓦战役是哈布斯堡军队与奥斯曼军队在1788至1791年奥土战争期间的一次交战。奥斯曼军队获胜，并击溃了奥地利军队。

en.t: The United States Department of War is established
en.s: The United States Department of War, also called the War Department (and occasionally War Office in the early years), was the United States Cabinet department responsible for the operation and maintenance of the United States Army. It also had responsibility for naval affairs from 1794 until the establishment of the Department of the Navy in 1798, and for most non-naval air forces until the creation of the Department of the Air Force on September 18, 1947.

zh.s: 美国战争部也称陆军部，在早期偶尔称为战争办公室，是美国内阁部门，负责美国陆军的运作和维护。1794年至1798年海军部成立前，该部门也负责海军事务；在1947年9月18日空军部成立前，还负责大部分非海军航空部队。

en.s: The Battle of Kenapacomaqua, also called the Battle of Old Town, was a raid in 1791 by United States forces under the command of Lieutenant Colonel (later Brigadier General) James Wilkinson on the Miami (Wea) town of Kenapacomaqua on the Eel River, approximately six miles upstream from present-day Logansport, Indiana.

zh.s: 肯纳帕科马夸战役又称老镇战役，是美国军队于1791年发动的一次突袭，由詹姆斯·威尔金森中校（后晋升准将）指挥，目标是位于鳗鱼河畔的迈阿密族（韦阿族）肯纳帕科马夸聚居地。该地距今印第安纳州洛根斯波特约6英里，位于其上游。

en.s: The Whiskey Rebellion (also known as the Whiskey Insurrection) was a violent tax protest in the United States beginning in 1791 and ending in 1794 during the presidency of George Washington. The so-called "whiskey tax" was the first tax imposed on a domestic product by the newly formed federal government. The "whiskey tax" became law in 1791, and was intended to generate revenue to pay the war debt incurred during the American Revolutionary War.
en.n: U.S. President George Washington invokes the Militia Acts of 1792 to suppress the Whiskey Rebellion in western Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 威士忌叛乱又称威士忌起义，是美国一场暴力税收抗议，始于1791年，至1794年结束，发生在乔治·华盛顿担任总统期间。所谓的“威士忌税”是新成立的联邦政府对国内产品征收的第一项税。该税于1791年成为法律，旨在筹集收入，以偿还美国独立战争期间欠下的战争债务。
zh.n: 美国总统乔治·华盛顿援引1792年《民兵法》，镇压宾夕法尼亚州西部的威士忌叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Boyacá (1819), also known as the Battle of Boyacá Bridge, was a decisive victory by a combined army of Venezuelan and New Granadan troops along with a British Legion led by General Simon Bolivar over the III Division of the Spanish Expeditionary Army of Costa Firme commanded by Spanish Colonel José María Barreiro. This victory ensured the success of Bolívar's campaign to liberate New Granada.

zh.s: 1819年的博亚卡战役又称博亚卡桥战役。西蒙·玻利瓦尔将军率领委内瑞拉和新格拉纳达联军以及英国军团，击败了由西班牙上校何塞·玛丽亚·巴雷罗指挥的哥斯达菲尔梅西班牙远征军第三师。这场胜利确保了玻利瓦尔解放新格拉纳达战役的成功。

en.s: The 1820 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on August 7, 1820. Acting Democratic-Republican Governor Gabriel Slaughter did not stand for re-election. Former U.S. Senator John Adair defeated Anthony Butler, Joseph Desha, and William Logan with 32.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1820年肯塔基州州长选举于1820年8月7日举行。民主共和党代理州长加布里埃尔·斯劳特没有竞选连任。前联邦参议员约翰·阿代尔击败安东尼·巴特勒、约瑟夫·德沙和威廉·洛根，得票率为32.83%。

en.s: The 1826 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on August 7, 1826, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Illinois. Democratic-Republican candidate and incumbent member of the Illinois Senate William Kinney defeated fellow Democratic-Republican candidates Samuel S. Thompson and James Adams.

zh.s: 1826年伊利诺伊州副州长选举于1826年8月7日举行。民主共和党候选人、时任伊利诺伊州参议员威廉·金尼击败了同为民主共和党候选人的塞缪尔·S·汤普森和詹姆斯·亚当斯。

en.s: The Katamanso War, also known as the Battle of Dodowa, was a war that several tribes united with the British, fought and prevented Ashantis from dominating the coast in 1826. Numerous tribes in the Gold Coast such as the Fantes, Ga, Akyems, Adas were led by the British army to fight the Ashantis. It is classified as one of the "Anglo-Ashanti Wars" according to historical evidence at the National Archives.

zh.s: 卡塔曼索战争又称多多瓦战役。1826年，多个部族与英国结盟作战，阻止阿散蒂人控制沿海地区。黄金海岸的芳蒂人、加人、阿基姆人和阿达族等部族由英军率领，共同对抗阿散蒂人。根据国家档案馆的历史资料，这场战争被归为“英阿散蒂战争”之一。

en.s: The 1837 Alabama gubernatorial election was an election held on August 7, 1837, to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic candidate Arthur P. Bagby beat Anti-Van Buren candidate Samuel W. Oliver with 54.79% of the vote.

en.s: The 1837 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on August 7, 1837. The Whig lieutenant governor of Indiana David Wallace defeated the Whig senator from Switzerland County John Dumont. For a time Wallace appeared to run unopposed, until the entry of Dumont and Democrat Gamaliel Taylor in late April.

en.s: The Simele massacre (Syriac: ܦܪܲܡܬܵܐ ܕܣܸܡܹܠܹܐ, romanized: Premta d'Simele, Arabic: مذبحة سميل, romanized: maḏbaḥat Simīl), also known as the Assyrian affair, was a massacre committed by the Kingdom of Iraq under the leadership of Kurdish army general Bakr Sidqi. The massacre was committed in August 1933 against the Assyrian population of Iraq in and around the village of Simele.
en.n: The Kingdom of Iraq slaughters over 3,000 Assyrians in the village of Simele. This date is recognized as Martyrs Day or National Day of Mourning by the Assyrian community in memory of the Simele massacre.

zh.s: 西梅莱大屠杀（叙利亚语：ܦܪܲܡܬܵܐ ܕܣܸܡܹܠܹܐ，转写：Premta d'Simele；阿拉伯语：مذبحة سميل，转写：maḏbaḥat Simīl）也称亚述人事件，是伊拉克王国在库尔德裔陆军将领巴克尔·西德奇指挥下实施的一场屠杀。1933年8月，伊拉克王国在西梅莱村及其周边杀害亚述人。
zh.n: 伊拉克王国在西梅莱村屠杀了3000多名亚述人。亚述社群将这一天定为殉难者日或全国哀悼日，以纪念西梅莱大屠杀。

en.s: The Battle of Tulagi and Gavutu–Tanambogo was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, between the forces of the Imperial Japanese Navy and Allied (mainly United States (U.S.) Marine) ground forces. It took place from 7–9 August 1942 on the Solomon Islands, during the initial Allied landings in the Guadalcanal campaign. In the battle, U.S. Marines, under the overall command of U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift, successfully landed and captured the islands of Tulagi, Gavutu, and Tanambogo among which the Japanese Navy had constructed a naval and seaplane base.

zh.t: 图拉吉岛和加武图—塔南博戈战役
zh.s: 图拉吉岛和加武图—塔南博戈战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场陆战，交战双方是日本帝国海军和盟军地面部队（主要为美国海军陆战队）。战斗于1942年8月7日至9日在所罗门群岛爆发，属于盟军瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役初期登陆行动的一部分。在亚历山大·范德格里夫特少将统一指挥下，美国海军陆战队成功登陆并攻占图拉吉岛、加武图岛和塔南博戈岛。日本海军此前在这些岛上修建了海军基地和水上飞机基地。

en.s: The Guadalcanal campaign, also known as the Battle of Guadalcanal and codenamed Operation Watchtower by the United States, was an Allied offensive against forces of the Empire of Japan in the Solomon Islands during the Pacific Theater of World War II. It was fought between 7 August 1942 and 9 February 1943, and involved major land and naval battles on and surrounding the island of Guadalcanal.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役又称瓜达尔卡纳尔战役，美国将其代号定为“瞭望塔行动”。这是第二次世界大战太平洋战场期间，盟军在所罗门群岛对日本帝国军队发动的一次攻势，时间为1942年8月7日至1943年2月9日。战役包括瓜达尔卡纳尔岛及周边地区的大规模陆战和海战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Vella Gulf (ベラ湾夜戦, Berawan yasen) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II fought on the night of 6–7 August 1943 in Vella Gulf between Vella Lavella and Kolombangara in the Solomon Islands of the southwest Pacific. This engagement was the first time that American destroyers were allowed to operate independently of the American cruiser force during the Pacific campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 维拉湾海战（日语：ベラ湾夜戦，罗马字：Berawan yasen）是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场海战，于1943年8月6日至7日晚在维拉拉维拉岛与科隆班加拉岛之间的西南太平洋维拉湾爆发。这是太平洋战役期间美军驱逐舰首次获准脱离巡洋舰部队独立行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Bluecoat was a British offensive in the Battle of Normandy, from 30 July until 7 August 1944, during the Second World War. The geographical objectives of the attack, undertaken by VIII Corps and XXX Corps of the British Second Army (Lieutenant-General Miles Dempsey), were to secure the road junction of Vire and the high ground of Mont Pinçon.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蓝衣行动是第二次世界大战诺曼底战役期间英国军队发动的一次攻势，从1944年7月30日持续至8月7日。攻势由英国第二集团军的第八军和第三十军执行，军团长为迈尔斯·邓普西中将，目标是夺取维尔的道路枢纽和蒙潘松高地。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of the Sittang Bend and the Japanese Breakout across Pegu Yomas were linked Japanese military operations during the Burma Campaign, which took place nearly at the end of World War II. Surviving elements of the Imperial Japanese Army who had been driven into the Pegu Yoma attempted to break out eastwards in order to join other Japanese troops retreating from the British forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 锡当河湾战役与日军穿越勃固山脉突围，是缅甸战役中相互关联的两项日军军事行动，发生在第二次世界大战接近尾声时。被赶入勃固山脉的日军残部试图向东突围，与其他正从英军面前撤退的日军会合。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Burma campaign in the South-East Asian theatre of World War II was fought primarily by British Commonwealth, China and United States forces against the forces of Imperial Japan, who were assisted by the Burmese National Army, the Indian National Army, and to some degree by Thailand. The British Commonwealth land forces were drawn primarily from the United Kingdom, British India and Africa.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战东南亚战场的缅甸战役，主要由英联邦、中国和美国军队对抗日本帝国军队；缅甸国民军、印度国民军以及一定程度上的泰国军队协助日军。英联邦陆军部队主要来自英国、英属印度和非洲。

en.t: The government of the Soviet Union presented a note to its Turkish counterparts which refuted the latter's sovereignty over the Turkish Straits, thus beginning the Turkish Straits crisis
en.s: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. It was the world's third-most populous country, the largest by area, and bordered twelve other countries. A diverse multinational state, it was organized as a federal union of national republics, with the largest and most populous being the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (SFSR).

zh.t: 苏联政府向土耳其提交照会，否认土耳其对土耳其海峡的主权，土耳其海峡危机由此开始
zh.s: 苏联正式名称为苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（USSR），是一个横跨欧亚大陆的国家，从1922年成立到1991年解体。它曾是世界人口第三多、面积最大的国家，与其他12个国家接壤。苏联是由多个民族组成的联邦国家，由各加盟共和国构成，其中最大、人口最多的是俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国（SFSR）。

en.s: The Battle of Karang Resik was a battle in Karang Resik, Tasikmalaya, West Java that took place in 1947. It cost many lives, ending in an Indonesian victory, despite Indonesia's far weaker military.

zh.s: 卡朗雷西克战役发生于1947年，是印度尼西亚西爪哇省塔西克马拉亚卡朗雷西克地区的一场战斗。战斗造成多人死亡；尽管印尼军力弱得多，最终仍取得胜利。

en.t: 1948 Liberal Party of Canada leadership election
en.s: In 1948, the Liberal Party of Canada held a leadership election to replace retiring Liberal leader and sitting Prime Minister William Lyon Mackenzie King. Secretary of State for External Affairs Louis St. Laurent defeated Minister of Agriculture (and former Premier of Saskatchewan) James Garfield Gardiner and former cabinet minister Charles Gavan Power on the first ballot, and would be sworn in as prime minister later that year.

zh.s: 1948年，加拿大自由党举行党魁选举，以接替即将退休的党魁、时任总理威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金。外交国务卿路易·圣洛朗在首轮投票中击败农业部长（曾任萨斯喀彻温省省长）詹姆斯·加菲尔德·加德纳，以及前内阁部长查尔斯·加万·鲍尔。同年晚些时候，圣洛朗宣誓就任总理。

en.s: The Darul Islam rebellion (Indonesian: Pemberontakan Darul Islam) was a war waged between 1949 and 1962 by the Islamic State of Indonesia, commonly known as Darul Islam, to establish an Islamic state in Indonesia. The rebellion was launched by Sekarmadji Maridjan Kartosoewirjo, a former Indonesian nationalist who refused to recognize the new Republic of Indonesia. Instead, he proclaimed the establishment of the Islamic State of Indonesia on 7 August 1949.

zh.s: 达鲁伊斯兰叛乱（印度尼西亚语：Pemberontakan Darul Islam）是印度尼西亚伊斯兰国（通常称为达鲁伊斯兰）于1949年至1962年发动的一场战争，目的是在印度尼西亚建立伊斯兰国家。叛乱由前印度尼西亚民族主义者卡尔托苏维约发起；他拒绝承认新成立的印度尼西亚共和国，并于1949年8月7日宣布建立印度尼西亚伊斯兰国。

en.s: The Operation Pagar Betis (Indonesian:Operasi Pagar Betis) was a counter-insurgent operation conducted by the Indonesian Army to blockade the Darul Islam main base to reduce their guerilla movement and eliminate their supplies lines. This operation was a success and effectively ended the rebellion with the surrender of Darul Islam forces by Kartosoewirjo.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕加尔贝蒂斯行动（印度尼西亚语：Operasi Pagar Betis）是印度尼西亚陆军开展的一次反叛乱行动，旨在封锁达鲁伊斯兰的主要基地，限制其游击活动并切断补给线。行动取得成功，卡尔托苏维约率领的达鲁伊斯兰部队投降，叛乱也因此基本结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Wanshan Archipelago Campaign (Chinese: 万山群岛战役) was a campaign fought between nationalist and communist forces for the control of Wanshan Archipelago (Wanshan Qundao, 万山群岛), and resulted in communist victory. The archipelago consists of 48 islands strategically located at the mouth of the Pearl River, a chokepoint on the communication lines to Hong Kong and Macau.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 万山群岛战役（中文：万山群岛战役）是国民党和共产党军队争夺万山群岛（万山群岛）的战役，最终以共产党获胜告终。该群岛由48座岛屿组成，战略位置重要，坐落于珠江口，是通往香港和澳门的交通线咽喉。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Explorer program: Explorer 6 launches from the Atlantic Missile Range in Cape Canaveral, Florida
en.s: Explorer 6, or S-2, was a NASA satellite, launched on 7 August 1959, at 14:24:20 GMT. It was a small, spherical satellite designed to study trapped radiation of various energies, galactic cosmic rays, geomagnetism, radio propagation in the upper atmosphere, and the flux of micrometeorites. It also tested a scanning device designed for photographing the Earth's cloud cover.

zh.t: 探险者计划：探险者6号从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角的大西洋导弹靶场发射
zh.s: 探险者6号又称S-2，是美国国家航空航天局的一颗卫星，于1959年8月7日格林尼治标准时间14时24分20秒发射。它是一颗小型球形卫星，设计用于研究不同能量的俘获辐射、银河宇宙射线、地磁、上层大气中的无线电传播以及微流星体通量。它还测试了一种用于拍摄地球云层的扫描装置。

en.t: Ivory Coast becomes independent from France
en.s: Ivory Coast, also known as Côte d'Ivoire and officially as the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, is a country on the southern coast of West Africa. Its capital city of Yamoussoukro is located in the centre of the country, while its largest city and economic centre is the port city of Abidjan.

zh.t: 科特迪瓦脱离法国独立
zh.s: 科特迪瓦又称象牙海岸，正式名称为科特迪瓦共和国，是西非南岸的国家。首都亚穆苏克罗位于该国中部，最大城市和经济中心则是港口城市阿比让。

en.t: Canadian-born American pharmacologist Frances Oldham Kelsey is awarded the U.S. President's Award for Distinguished Federal Civilian Service for her refusal to authorize thalidomide
en.s: Frances Kathleen Oldham Kelsey (née Oldham; July 24, 1914 – August 7, 2015) was a Canadian-American pharmacologist and physician who had a 45-year career with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). As a reviewer, she refused to authorize thalidomide for market because she had concerns about the lack of evidence regarding the drug's safety. Her concerns proved to be justified when it was shown that thalidomide caused serious birth defects.

zh.t: 出生于加拿大的美国药理学家弗朗西丝·奥尔德姆·凯尔西因拒绝批准沙利度胺，获颁美国总统杰出联邦文职服务奖
zh.s: 弗朗西丝·凯瑟琳·奥尔德姆·凯尔西（娘家姓奥尔德姆；1914年7月24日—2015年8月7日）是加拿大裔美国药理学家和医生，在美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）任职45年。作为审查员，她因担忧缺乏药物安全性的证据而拒绝批准沙利度胺上市。后来证实沙利度胺会导致严重出生缺陷，她的担忧也因此被证明是正确的。

en.s: The Gulf of Tonkin Resolution or the Southeast Asia Resolution, Pub. L. 88–408, 78 Stat. 384, enacted August 10, 1964, was a joint resolution that the United States Congress passed on August 7, 1964, in response to the Gulf of Tonkin incident. It is of historic significance because it gave U.S. president Lyndon B. Johnson authorization, without a formal declaration of war by Congress, to use conventional military force in Southeast Asia.
en.n: Vietnam War: The U.S. Congress passes the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution giving U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson broad war powers to deal with North Vietnamese attacks on American forces.

zh.s: 《东京湾决议》又称《东南亚决议》，公法第88-408号、美国法令汇编第78卷第384页，于1964年8月10日正式生效。美国国会于1964年8月7日为回应东京湾事件通过了这项联合决议。该决议具有重要历史意义，因为它授权美国总统林登·约翰逊在没有国会正式宣战的情况下，在东南亚使用常规军事力量。
zh.n: 越南战争：美国国会通过《东京湾决议》，授予美国总统林登·约翰逊广泛的战争权力，以应对北越对美军的袭击。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mauritania on 7 August 1966. Following the merger of all the country's political parties into the Mauritanian People's Party (PPM), the country had become a one-party state in December 1961. Its leader, incumbent President Moktar Ould Daddah, was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed. Voter turnout was 96.2%.

zh.s: 毛里塔尼亚于1966年8月7日举行总统选举。全国各政党于1961年12月合并为毛里塔尼亚人民党（PPM）后，该国成为一党制国家。该党领袖、时任总统穆赫塔尔·乌尔德·达达赫是唯一候选人，没有对手便成功连任。投票率为96.2%。

en.s: Operation Truong Cong Dinh (also known as Operation People's Road), was a United States and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) security operation to reestablish South Vietnamese control over the northern Mekong Delta in the aftermath of the Tet Offensive. The operation aimed to root out Viet Cong (VC) forces in the area, and to stop them from attacking traffic on the nearby Highway 4.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 张公定行动又称“人民之路行动”，是美国和越南共和国军开展的一项治安行动，旨在春节攻势后重新确立南越对湄公河北部三角洲的控制。行动目标是清剿当地越共武装，并阻止他们袭击附近的4号公路交通。

en.s: The National Congress of American Indians (NCAI) is an American Indigenous rights organization. It was founded in 1944 to represent the tribes and resist U.S. federal government pressure for termination of tribal rights and forced assimilation of Native Americans (including Alaska Natives). These were in contradiction of their treaty rights and status as sovereign entities. The organization continues to be an association of federally recognized and state-recognized American Indian and Alaska Native tribes.
en.n: Richard Nixon appoints Luis R. Bruce, a Mohawk-Oglala Sioux and co-founder of the National Congress of American Indians, as the new commissioner of the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

zh.t: 美国印第安人全国大会
zh.s: 美国印第安人全国大会（NCAI）是一个争取美国原住民权利的组织，成立于1944年，旨在代表各部族，抵制美国联邦政府终止部族权利、强迫原住民（包括阿拉斯加原住民）同化的压力。这些做法违背了各部族的条约权利，也不承认他们作为主权实体的地位。该组织至今仍是一个由联邦和州政府承认的美洲印第安人及阿拉斯加原住民部族组成的协会。
zh.n: 理查德·尼克松任命美国印第安人全国大会共同创办人、莫霍克族与奥格拉拉苏族人路易斯·R·布鲁斯为印第安事务局新局长。

en.s: The 1971 FA Charity Shield was a football match between Leicester City and Liverpool at Filbert Street on Saturday 7 August 1971. Arsenal won the double in 1970–71 but were unable to take part in the Charity Shield because they had contracted to go on a pre-season tour that clashed with the fixture. The 1971 FA Cup Final runners-up Liverpool and Second Division winners Leicester City were invited to take part instead.

zh.s: 1971年英格兰足总慈善盾于1971年8月7日星期六在菲尔伯特街球场举行，由莱斯特城对阵利物浦。阿森纳在1970–71赛季赢得双冠王，但因已安排与比赛日期冲突的季前巡回赛，无法参加慈善盾。赛事因此邀请了1971年足总杯决赛亚军利物浦和英格兰足球乙级联赛冠军莱斯特城参赛。

en.s: The Viking program consisted of a pair of identical American space probes, Viking 1 and Viking 2 both launched in 1975, and landed on Mars in 1976. The mission effort began in 1968 and was managed by the NASA Langley Research Center. Each spacecraft was composed of two main parts: an orbiter spacecraft which photographed the surface of Mars from orbit, and a lander which studied the planet from the surface.
en.n: Viking program: Viking 2 enters orbit around Mars.

zh.s: 海盗号计划包括两艘相同的美国太空探测器：海盗1号和海盗2号。两艘探测器均于1975年发射，并于1976年在火星着陆。该任务于1968年启动，由美国国家航空航天局兰利研究中心管理。每艘探测器都由两部分组成：轨道器从火星轨道拍摄其表面，着陆器则在火星地表开展研究。
zh.n: 海盗2号进入火星轨道。

en.t: U.S. President Jimmy Carter declares a federal emergency at Love Canal due to toxic waste that had been disposed of negligently
en.s: James Earl Carter Jr. (October 1, 1924 – December 29, 2024) was an American politician and humanitarian who served as the 39th president of the United States from 1977 to 1981. A member of the Democratic Party, Carter served as the 76th governor of Georgia from 1971 to 1975 and in the Georgia State Senate from 1963 to 1967.

zh.s: 小詹姆斯·厄尔·卡特（1924年10月1日—2024年12月29日）是美国政治人物和人道主义者，1977年至1981年担任美国第39任总统。他是民主党成员，1971年至1975年担任佐治亚州第76任州长，1963年至1967年任佐治亚州参议员。

en.s: The Clontibret invasion was an incursion by Ulster loyalists into the small Monaghan village of Clontibret, in the Republic of Ireland, on 7 August 1986. After crossing the border the loyalists proceeded to vandalize many buildings in the village and beat up two police officers before being dispersed by the Garda Síochána. The incident occurred in the context of unionist opposition to the recently signed Anglo-Irish Agreement.

zh.s: 1986年8月7日，阿尔斯特效忠派越境进入爱尔兰共和国莫纳亨郡的小村庄克朗蒂布雷。入侵者破坏了村中多栋建筑，并殴打两名警察，随后被爱尔兰警察驱散。事件发生时，工会派正反对刚签署不久的《英爱协定》。

A special section paying tribute to writer Ennio Flaiano, who worked on such films as La Notte and La Dolce Vita, was screened. Another retrospective tribute section was held for deceased Swiss actor François Simon. A ceremony dedicated to him was attended by his colleagues Jeanne Moreau, Alan Tanner, Thomas Koerfer, and Daniel Schmid.

en.t: First American soldiers arrive in Saudi Arabia as part of the Gulf War
en.s: The Gulf War was an armed conflict between Iraq and a 42-country coalition led by the United States in response to Saddam Hussein invading neighboring Kuwait on 2 August 1990. The coalition's efforts were in two phases: Operation Desert Shield, which marked the military buildup from August 1990 to January 1991; and Operation Desert Storm, from the bombing campaign against Iraq on 17 January until the American-led liberation of Kuwait on 28 February.

zh.s: 海湾战争是美国领导的42国联军为回应萨达姆·侯赛因于1990年8月2日入侵邻国科威特而与伊拉克发生的武装冲突。联军行动分为两个阶段：“沙漠盾牌行动”是1990年8月至1991年1月的军事集结；“沙漠风暴行动”则从1991年1月17日对伊拉克发动轰炸开始，至2月28日由美国领导的联军解放科威特结束。

en.s: The 1993 Football Association Charity Shield was the 71st FA Charity Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup competitions. It was held at Wembley Stadium on 7 August 1993. The match was played between Arsenal, who beat Sheffield Wednesday to win the 1993 FA Cup Final, and Manchester United, champions of the inaugural Premier League competition.

en.s: The men's football competition at the 1994 Goodwill Games consisted of a single all-star match on 7 August 1994. It was played between Russia and a World XI at Kirov Stadium in Saint Petersburg, Russia. This was the first instance of football being played at the Goodwill Games. Russia defeated the World All-Stars 2–1 to win the football competition.

zh.s: 1994年友好运动会男子足球赛只有一场全明星赛，于1994年8月7日在俄罗斯圣彼得堡的基洛夫体育场举行，由俄罗斯队对阵世界联队。这是足球首次成为友好运动会的比赛项目。俄罗斯队以2比1击败世界全明星队，赢得该项足球比赛。

The match was played at the Olympiastadion, Munich, and contested by league champions Bayern Munich and cup winners Werder Bremen.

en.s: The White Earthquake (Spanish: Terremoto Blanco) was a climatic event consisting of intense winds, cold, snowfall and rain that occurred through southern Chile in August 1995. 7,176 people were left isolated as result of the heavy snowfall and three died. By 16 August, an estimated 176,000 sheep were dead, and 800,000 were in "critical condition". Besides agriculture, the forestry sector was also paralysed.
en.n: The Chilean government declares state of emergency in the southern half of the country in response to an event of intense, cold, wind, rain and snowfall known as the White Earthquake.

zh.s: 白色地震（西班牙语：Terremoto Blanco）是1995年8月影响智利南部的一场气候灾害，伴有强风、严寒、降雪和降雨。大雪导致7,176人受困，另有3人死亡。截至8月16日，估计有176,000只羊死亡，800,000只处于“危急状态”。除农业外，林业也陷入瘫痪。
zh.n: 智利政府因应“白色地震”宣布该国南半部进入紧急状态；这场灾害伴有强烈严寒、大风、降雨和降雪。

en.s: Fine Air Flight 101 was a scheduled cargo flight from Miami International Airport to Las Américas International Airport, operated by Douglas DC-8 N27UA, that crashed almost immediately after take-off on August 7, 1997, when it failed to gain altitude. All four people on board and one person on the ground died in the mid-day Thursday crash.

zh.s: Fine Air 101号航班是一班从迈阿密国际机场飞往美洲国际机场的定期货运航班，由编号N27UA的道格拉斯DC-8执飞。1997年8月7日，飞机起飞后几乎立即因未能爬升而坠毁。事故发生在周四中午，机上4人和地面1人全部遇难。

en.s: The 1998 United States embassy bombings were attacks that occurred on August 7, 1998, in which over 200 people were killed in nearly simultaneous truck bomb explosions in two East African cities, one at the United States Embassy in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, the other at the United States Embassy in Nairobi, Kenya. The attacks, which were linked to local members of the Egyptian Islamic Jihad, brought Osama bin Laden, Ayman al-Zawahiri, and their terrorist organization, al-Qaeda, to the attention of the American public for the first time, and resulted in the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) placing bin Laden on its ten most-wanted fugitives list.

zh.s: 1998年8月7日，坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆和肯尼亚内罗毕的美国使馆几乎同时遭卡车炸弹袭击，造成200多人死亡。袭击与埃及伊斯兰圣战组织的当地成员有关，使奥萨马·本·拉登、艾曼·扎瓦希里及其恐怖组织基地组织首次受到美国公众关注。此后，联邦调查局（FBI）将本·拉登列入十大通缉逃犯名单。

en.s: Many terrorist attacks have occurred in Kenya during the 20th and 21st centuries. In 1980, the Jewish-owned Norfolk hotel was attacked by the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO). In 1998, the US embassy was bombed in Nairobi, as was the Israeli-owned Paradise hotel in 2002 in Mombasa. In 2013, the Somali jihadist group al-Shabaab killed 67 people at Nairobi's Westgate Shopping Mall. There have also been many other attacks.

en.s: The 1999 war in Dagestan, also known as the Dagestan incursions (Russian: Война в Дагестане), was an armed conflict that began when the Ichkerian-based Islamic International Peacekeeping Brigade (IIPB), an Islamist group led by Shamil Basayev, Ibn al-Khattab, Ramzan Akhmadov and Arbi Barayev, invaded the neighboring Russian republic of Dagestan on 7 August 1999. They did so in support of the Shura of Dagestan separatist rebels.

zh.s: 1999年达吉斯坦战争又称达吉斯坦入侵（俄语：Война в Дагестане），是一场武装冲突。1999年8月7日，伊奇克里亚方面的伊斯兰国际维和旅入侵邻近的俄罗斯达吉斯坦共和国。该组织是一个伊斯兰主义武装团体，由沙米尔·巴萨耶夫、伊本·哈塔卜、拉姆赞·艾哈迈多夫和阿尔比·巴拉耶夫领导。入侵行动旨在支持达吉斯坦舒拉委员会领导的分离主义叛军。

en.t: 2000 Democratic Party vice presidential candidate selection
en.s: This article lists those who were potential candidates for the Democratic nomination for Vice President of the United States in the 2000 election. Incumbent Vice President Al Gore won the 2000 Democratic nomination for President of the United States, and chose Connecticut Senator Joseph Lieberman as his running mate on August 7, 2000. Lieberman, a centrist two-term Democratic senator, was chosen for being "tough on defense" and foreign policy issues.

zh.s: 本文列出了2000年美国大选中可能获得民主党副总统提名的人选。时任副总统阿尔·戈尔赢得民主党总统候选人提名后，于2000年8月7日选择康涅狄格州参议员约瑟夫·利伯曼作为竞选搭档。利伯曼是中间派民主党人，已连任两届参议员；戈尔看中他在国防和外交政策问题上“态度强硬”。

en.s: The 2010 DFL-Supercup marked the return of the German Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. The competition had not been played in an official capacity since 1996, and was replaced by the DFB Liga-Pokal from 1997 to 2007. For the previous two years, an unofficial super cup had been contested. The match was played at the Impuls Arena in Augsburg on 7 August 2010, and was contested by 2009–10 Bundesliga and 2009–10 DFB-Pokal double winners Bayern Munich, and league runners-up Schalke 04.

en.s: The 2011 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield sponsored by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 89th FA Community Shield, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup competitions. The match was the 160th Manchester derby between Manchester United and Manchester City and played at Wembley Stadium, London, on 7 August 2011.

zh.s: 2011年英格兰社区盾是第89届社区盾赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季英超和足总杯冠军参加。本场比赛是曼联与曼城之间的第160场曼彻斯特德比，于2011年8月7日在伦敦温布利球场举行。因赞助关系，赛事也称为“麦当劳赞助的英格兰足总社区盾”。

en.s: The 2011 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira was the 33rd edition of the Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira, the annual Portuguese football season-opening match contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and cup competitions (or cup runner-up in case the league- and cup-winning club is the same). The 2011 edition opposed Porto, the 2010–11 Primeira Liga and 2010–11 Taça de Portugal title holders, and Vitória de Guimarães, the 2010–11 Taça de Portugal runners-up.

zh.t: 2011年坎迪多·德·奥利维拉超级杯
zh.s: 2011年坎迪多·德·奥利维拉超级杯是第33届赛事。这项葡萄牙年度赛季揭幕战由上赛季顶级联赛和杯赛冠军参加；若同一球队包揽联赛和杯赛冠军，则由杯赛亚军参赛。2011年赛事由波尔图对阵吉马良斯维多利亚。波尔图是2010–11赛季葡超和葡萄牙杯冠军，吉马良斯维多利亚则是该赛季葡萄牙杯亚军。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe in 2011, the first round beginning on 17 July 2011 with a run-off held on 7 August 2011. Incumbent President Fradique de Menezes had served the maximum two terms and could not constitutionally seek a third term. The final result saw former president Manuel Pinto da Costa, aged 74, elected in a narrow victory against Speaker of Parliament Evaristo Carvalho.

zh.t: 2011年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于2011年举行总统选举，首轮投票于7月17日开始，第二轮于2011年8月7日举行。时任总统弗拉迪克·德梅内泽斯已达到两届任期上限，依法不能竞选第三届。最终，74岁的前总统曼努埃尔·平托·达科斯塔以微弱优势击败议会议长埃瓦里斯托·卡瓦略，当选总统。

en.s: The 2012 Indian vice presidential election was held on 7 August 2012 to elect the vice president of India. Mohammad Hamid Ansari was the incumbent and the UPA candidate. The other prime candidate was the NDA's Jaswant Singh. Ansari then reelected as vice president. In doing so, he became the first VP to be reelected since Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan in 1957.

zh.s: 印度于2012年8月7日举行副总统选举。时任副总统穆罕默德·哈米德·安萨里是执政联盟团结进步联盟（UPA）的候选人，主要对手是全国民主联盟（NDA）的贾斯万特·辛格。安萨里成功连任，成为自1957年萨瓦帕利·拉达克里希南以来首位连任的副总统。

en.s: The Shesh Aba raid was a raid by the British Special Air Service in Shesh Aba village, Nimruz Province, Afghanistan on August 7, 2012, during which British armed forces killed two young parents and injured their two sons. The commander of the special forces did not report the fatal incident to military police.

zh.s: 2012年8月7日，英国特种空勤团突袭阿富汗尼姆鲁兹省谢什阿巴村。英国军人杀死一对年轻父母，并打伤他们的两个儿子。特种部队指挥官没有将这起致命事件报告给宪兵。

en.s: Operation Sinai was an Egyptian military campaign, launched in early August 2012, against Islamic militants within the Sinai Peninsula to crush the Sinai Insurgency. The operation came as a direct response to the 2012 Egyptian-Israeli border attack on 5 August 2012. The operation was initially reported as part of "Operation Nisr" (Operation Eagle), but on 3 September 2012, the Egyptian army issued a statement requesting media sources to use the official name "Operation Sinai."

en.s: The 2013 Suruga Bank Championship (Japanese: スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2013; Spanish: Copa Suruga Bank 2013) was the sixth edition of the Suruga Bank Championship, the club football match co-organized by the Japan Football Association, the football governing body of Japan, CONMEBOL, the football governing body of South America, and J. League, the professional football league of Japan, between the winners of the previous season's J. League Cup and Copa Sudamericana. The match was contested between Japanese team Kashima Antlers, the 2012 J. League Cup champion, and Brazilian team São Paulo, the 2012 Copa Sudamericana champion. It was hosted by Kashima Antlers at the Kashima Soccer Stadium in Kashima on August 7, 2013.

zh.s: 2013年骏河银行锦标赛（日语：スルガ銀行チャンピオンシップ2013；西班牙语：Copa Suruga Bank 2013）是第六届骏河银行锦标赛。这项俱乐部足球赛事由日本足球协会、南美洲足球管理机构南美足联，以及日本职业足球联赛共同主办，参赛双方为上赛季日本联赛杯和南美杯冠军。比赛由日本球队鹿岛鹿角对阵巴西球队圣保罗，双方分别是2012年日本联赛杯和南美杯冠军。比赛于2013年8月7日在鹿岛鹿角主场鹿岛足球场举行。

en.s: The 66th Locarno Film Festival was held from 7 to 17 August 2013 in Locarno, Switzerland. There were 20 films in the main competition of which 18 were world premieres and two were international premieres. In the Filmmakers of the Present competition 14 out of the 16 films were from first time directors.

en.s: The 2014 No Surrender (also known as Impact Wrestling: No Surrender) was a professional wrestling television special produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It took place on August 7, 2014 at the Manhattan Center Grand Ballroom in Midtown Manhattan, New York City, New York. It was the tenth event under the No Surrender chronology. It aired as a special edition of TNA's weekly broadcast of Impact Wrestling on September 17, 2014.

zh.s: 2014年《No Surrender》（又称《Impact Wrestling: No Surrender》）是Total Nonstop Action Wrestling（TNA）制作的一档职业摔角电视特别节目，于2014年8月7日在纽约市曼哈顿中城的曼哈顿中心大宴会厅举行。这是“No Surrender”系列的第十场赛事。该节目于9月17日作为TNA每周节目《Impact Wrestling》的特别版播出。

zh.s: 2014年沙特超级杯是第二届沙特超级杯。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季沙特职业联赛和国王杯冠军参加。比赛于2014年8月7日举行，由2013–14赛季沙特职业联赛冠军利雅得胜利对阵2014年国王杯冠军利雅得青年。

en.s: The Battle of Arsal was a major combat engagement between Lebanese forces, and Salafi jihadist militants groups from Syria at the town of Arsal in the Baalbek-Hermel Governorate of Lebanon. It involved soldiers from the Lebanese Armed Forces, Hezbollah fighters, and militants affiliated with the Al-Nusra Front and Islamic State. The Syrian Air Force also had limited involvement during the battle.

en.s: Fights on the Ukrainian–Russian border in 2014, also called the Operation to restore the state border, the Battle at the border, the Battle in sector D, the Izvarinsky Encirclement, and the Dovzhansky Encirclement, was a phase of the war in Donbas in which the Armed Forces of Ukraine fought Russian-backed separatist forces over control of areas of Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts.

zh.t: 乌克兰—俄罗斯边境战斗（2014年）
zh.s: 2014年乌克兰—俄罗斯边境战斗也称恢复国境行动、边境战役、D区战役、伊兹瓦里涅包围战和多夫然斯基包围战，是顿巴斯战争的一个阶段。乌克兰武装部队与俄罗斯支持的分离主义武装交战，争夺顿涅茨克州和卢甘斯克州部分地区的控制权。

en.s: On August 7, 2015, jihadists from Al-Mourabitoun and Katiba Macina attacked the Byblos Hotel in Sévaré, Mali. The attack was one of the largest attacks against civilians in Mopti Region during the Mali War, and led to the deaths of thirteen people, including five civilians.

zh.s: 2015年8月7日，阿尔穆拉比通组织和马西纳旅的武装分子袭击了马里塞瓦雷的拜布洛斯酒店。这是马里战争期间莫普提大区针对平民的最大规模袭击之一，造成13人死亡，其中包括5名平民。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 17 July 2016. Initial results suggested Evaristo Carvalho of Independent Democratic Action had been elected in the first round of voting, defeating incumbent President Manuel Pinto da Costa; however, the results was subsequently annulled, necessitating a second round between Carvalho and Pinto da Costa, which was held on 7 August.

zh.t: 2016年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于2016年7月17日举行总统选举。初步结果显示，独立民主行动党的埃瓦里斯托·卡瓦略在首轮投票中击败时任总统曼努埃尔·平托·达科斯塔，当选总统；但随后选举结果被取消，因此需要举行第二轮投票。卡瓦略与平托·达科斯塔于8月7日参加第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2016 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield supported by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 94th FA Community Shield, an annual English football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup. The match was contested by 2015–16 FA Cup winners Manchester United, and Leicester City, champions of the 2015–16 Premier League.

zh.s: 2016年英格兰社区盾是第94届社区盾赛事。这项英格兰年度足球比赛由上赛季英超和足总杯冠军参加。参赛双方为2015–16赛季足总杯冠军曼联和英超冠军莱斯特城。因赞助关系，赛事也称为“麦当劳支持的英格兰足总社区盾”。

en.s: A special election for Ohio's 12th congressional district was held on August 7, 2018, following the resignation of Republican U.S. Representative Pat Tiberi. The Republican Party nominated State Senator Troy Balderson for the seat while the Democratic Party nominated Franklin County Recorder Danny O'Connor. Balderson led O'Connor in preliminary results; however, the race was not officially called on election night.

zh.t: 2018年俄亥俄州第12选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 俄亥俄州第12选区联邦众议员特别选举于2018年8月7日举行，起因是共和党联邦众议员帕特·蒂贝里辞职。共和党提名州参议员特洛伊·巴尔德森，民主党提名富兰克林县登记官丹尼·奥康纳。初步计票中，巴尔德森领先奥康纳，但选举结果在投票当晚尚未正式确认。

League YBC Levain Cup / CONMEBOL Sudamericana Championship Final (Japanese: JリーグYBCルヴァンカップ/CONMEBOLスダメリカーナ 王者決定戦2019 KANAGAWA), was the 12th edition of the J.League Cup / Copa Sudamericana Championship (previously referred to as the Suruga Bank Championship until 2018), the club football match co-organized by the Japan Football Association, the football governing body of Japan, CONMEBOL, the football governing body of South America, and J.League, the professional football league of Japan, between the champions of the previous season's J.League Cup and Copa Sudamericana. The match was contested between Japanese team Shonan Bellmare, the 2018 J.League Cup champions, and Brazilian team Athletico Paranaense, the 2018 Copa Sudamericana champions. It was hosted by Shonan Bellmare at the Shonan BMW Stadium Hiratsuka in Hiratsuka on 7 August 2019.

zh.t: 2019年日本联赛杯／南美杯锦标赛
zh.s: 2019年日本联赛杯／南美杯锦标赛的官方名称为“2019年日本联赛杯YBC Levain杯／南美足联南美杯冠军决胜赛”（日语：JリーグYBCルヴァンカップ/CONMEBOLスダメリカーナ 王者決定戦2019 KANAGAWA），是该赛事第12届比赛。赛事此前一直称为骏河银行锦标赛，2018年起更名。比赛由日本足球协会、南美足联和日本职业足球联赛共同主办，参赛双方为上赛季日本联赛杯和南美杯冠军。日本湘南比马（2018年日本联赛杯冠军）对阵巴西巴拉纳竞技（2018年南美杯冠军）。比赛由湘南比马主办，于2019年8月7日在平塚市的湘南宝马球场举行。

en.t: Air India Express Flight 1344 overshoots the runway at Calicut International Airport in the Malappuram district of Kerala, India, and crashes, killing 21 of the 190 people on board
en.s: Air India Express Flight 1344 was a scheduled international flight operated by a Boeing 737-800 on 7 August 2020 from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, to Kozhikode, India, landing at Calicut International Airport. The flight was part of the Vande Bharat Mission to repatriate Indian nationals stranded due to the COVID-19 pandemic. The flight crew aborted two landing attempts because of heavy rain and tailwind.

zh.t: 印度航空快运1344号班机在印度喀拉拉邦马拉普兰县卡利卡特国际机场冲出跑道并坠毁，机上190人中有21人遇难
zh.s: 印度航空快运1344号班机是一趟定期国际航班，2020年8月7日由一架波音737-800执飞，从阿联酋迪拜飞往印度科泽科德，并降落在卡利卡特国际机场。该航班属于“万德·巴拉特行动”，旨在接回因新冠疫情滞留海外的印度公民。由于暴雨和顺风，机组人员中止了两次降落尝试。

en.s: The 2021 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield supported by McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 99th FA Community Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League, Manchester City, and the winners of the previous season's FA Cup, Leicester City. This was Manchester City's first FA Community Shield appearance since 2019 when they beat Liverpool 5–4 on penalties after a 1–1 draw, and Leicester's first since losing 2–1 to Manchester United in the 2016 edition. The game was played on 7 August 2021 at Wembley Stadium in Wembley, London, with Leicester beating Manchester City 1–0 with a 89th-minute penalty by Kelechi Iheanacho.

zh.s: 2021年英格兰社区盾杯（因赞助也称“麦当劳赞助的英格兰社区盾杯”）是第99届英格兰社区盾杯。这项年度足球赛由上赛季英超冠军曼城对阵足总杯冠军莱斯特城。曼城上一次参加该赛事是在2019年，当时他们与利物浦常规时间战成1比1，点球大战以5比4获胜；莱斯特城上一次参赛是在2016年，当时以1比2负于曼联。本届比赛于2021年8月7日在伦敦温布利球场举行，莱斯特城凭借凯莱奇·伊希纳乔第89分钟罚进的点球，以1比0击败曼城。

en.t: Football at the 2020 Summer Olympics – Men's tournament final
en.s: The 2020 Summer Olympic football gold medal match was a football match to determine the gold medal winners of men's football tournament at the 2020 Summer Olympics. The match was the 25th final of the men's football tournament at the Olympics, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of FIFA to decide the Olympic champions. The match was held at International Stadium Yokohama in Yokohama, Japan, on 7 August 2021.

en.s: The 2021 Lebanese Super Cup was the 21st Lebanese Super Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Lebanese Premier League and Lebanese FA Cup. As Ansar won both competitions in 2021, their opponents were the 2020–21 league runners-up Nejmeh. The match was played at the Fouad Chehab Stadium on 7 August 2021.

en.s: The 2021 Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand co-leadership election was held to elect a Green Party co-leader. The election was won on the first ballot by incumbent co-leader and List MP, James Shaw.

en.s: The 2022 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final, the 91st event of its kind and the culmination of the 2022 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, was played at Croke Park on 7 August 2022. Kilkenny defeated Cork in the final to win their 15th title.

zh.s: 2022年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛于2022年8月7日在克罗克公园举行，是第91届此类赛事，也是2022年锦标赛的收官战。同一天较早时候，2022年全爱尔兰中级和初级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛也在克罗克公园举行。基尔肯尼击败科克，赢得队史第15个冠军。

en.s: The 2022 Nagano gubernatorial election was held on 7 August 2022 to elect the next governor of Nagano (長野県, Nagano-ken), a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu island. en.s: The 2022 Gaza–Israel clashes code-named as Operation Breaking Dawn lasted from 5 to 7 August 2022. The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) conducted some 147 airstrikes in Gaza and Palestinian militants fired approximately 1,100 rockets towards Israel. The operation, ordered by Prime Minister Yair Lapid and Defense Minister Benny Gantz without prior Cabinet discussion or approval, followed a raid in Jenin in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, in which Israeli forces arrested Bassam al-Saadi, a leader of the Palestinian Islamic Jihad (PIJ) in that area.

zh.s: 代号为“破晓行动”的2022年加沙—以色列冲突持续于2022年8月5日至7日。以色列国防军在加沙发动约147次空袭，巴勒斯坦武装分子则向以色列发射约1100枚火箭弹。此次行动由总理亚伊尔·拉皮德和国防部长本尼·甘茨下令，未事先经过内阁讨论或批准。此前，以军在被占领的约旦河西岸杰宁发动突袭，逮捕了当地巴勒斯坦伊斯兰圣战组织领导人巴萨姆·萨阿迪。
